# Plugin API (phase 7): headers only. npp_plugin_api.h (C ABI), npp_compat.h (porting help),
# npp_msgs.h (NPPM_* numbers, generated by tools/gen-npp-msgs.py). Scintilla.h comes with them:
# plugins talk to the editors with SCI_* messages.
add_library(npp_plugin_api INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(npp_plugin_api INTERFACE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${NPP_SCINTILLA_DIR}/include)

# Output folder of the plugins built with the application: <build>/plugins/<name>/<library>
# (the upstream layout of an installed plugin; not loaded automatically: copy a folder to
# <settings>/plugins or <app>/plugins to use it).
set(NPP_PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins CACHE INTERNAL "")

# npp_add_plugin(<name> SOURCES ... [QT] [SHARED_RUNTIME] [OUTPUT_DIR <dir>])
#   Shared library <name>.dll (Windows) / lib<name>.so (Linux) in <OUTPUT_DIR>/<name>/.
#   QT: the plugin has a Qt user interface (links Qt6::Widgets).
#   SHARED_RUNTIME (MinGW): use the C++ runtime DLLs of the application instead of a static one
#   (needed when C++ exceptions leave the plugin; QT plugins always do).
function(npp_add_plugin name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "QT;SHARED_RUNTIME" "OUTPUT_DIR" "SOURCES" ${ARGN})
    if(NOT ARG_OUTPUT_DIR)
        set(ARG_OUTPUT_DIR ${NPP_PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR})
    endif()
    add_library(${name} MODULE ${ARG_SOURCES})
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE npp_plugin_api)
    if(ARG_QT)
        target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets)
    else()
        set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES AUTOMOC OFF AUTOUIC OFF AUTORCC OFF)
    endif()
    if(WIN32)
        set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
    else()
        set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES PREFIX "lib")
    endif()
    # Only the npp_plugin_* entry points are exported
    set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES
        OUTPUT_NAME ${name}
        C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ARG_OUTPUT_DIR}/${name}
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ARG_OUTPUT_DIR}/${name})
    foreach(cfg Debug Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel)
        string(TOUPPER ${cfg} CFG)
        set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES
            LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG} ${ARG_OUTPUT_DIR}/${name}
            RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG} ${ARG_OUTPUT_DIR}/${name})
    endforeach()
    if(MINGW AND NOT ARG_QT AND NOT ARG_SHARED_RUNTIME)
        # no dependency on libgcc_s / libstdc++ DLLs: a plugin without Qt loads in any MinGW or MSVC build
        target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE -static)
    endif()
endfunction()
